title: PPSTA Business System Modernization
text: Member and financial administration for the Philippine Public School Teachers Association
description: PPSTA's previous member and insurance system was a slow desktop application. This in-progress PHP/CakePHP 4.4 project is moving member and financial workflows to the web.
tech: PHP, CakePHP 4.4, MySQL-style SQL, Excel/PDF generation, authentication, authorization, audit logging
imageAlt: Architecture diagram of the CakePHP application, business modules, relational database operations, file workflows, and documented legacy-user synchronization; full FoxPro conversion scope is unverified
coreFeatures: Member management and profiling
Plans, premiums, new-business workflows, and DECS export
Loan applications, approvals, servicing, and remittances
Claims and beneficiary processing
Accounting, assessments, transactions, vouchers, and reports
Payroll, deductions, net-pay, and regional remittance uploads
User roles, permissions, audit trails, and Excel/PDF generation
projectHighlights: Modernized legacy operational workflows as a structured web-based business system
Led and coordinated a team of developers, overseeing architecture decisions, task delegation, and code reviews
Implemented data structures and workflows to support maintainable operations
Repository evidence confirms a legacy-user sync from posdcash; full FoxPro conversion details are not documented

title: FoxPro to MySQL Migrator
text: Windows desktop tool for moving FoxPro and dBase data into MySQL.
description: Manual FoxPro-to-MySQL migrations are repetitive and difficult to audit. This Windows WPF tool discovers DBF tables and memo files, maps schemas, and transfers records in batches with checkpoints and CSV issue reports.
imageAlt: Workflow showing DBF and memo files discovered, mapped, and batch-transferred to MySQL, with checkpoints, logs, and CSV issue reports
coreFeatures: Discovers DBF tables and reads associated FPT/DBT memo files
Maps source fields to MySQL types and creates destination tables
Transfers records in batches using full reload or patch load mode
Resumes from checkpoints and records progress in migration logs
Exports skipped, failed, and repaired record details to CSV
Configurable string handling and deleted-record behavior
limitations: Windows-only application because it uses WPF.
Full reload drops and recreates destination tables.
Safe string handling uses MySQL TEXT fields, which are unsuitable for some keys and indexes.

title: Semantic Search Web API
description: A .NET 8 API that searches by meaning rather than exact keywords. It compares text embeddings and ranks results by similarity, with local and ONNX-backed options.
highlights: Dual embedding providers: ML.NET TF-IDF (local, fast) and ONNX Runtime (neural networks)
384-dimensional vector embeddings with cosine similarity ranking
Customizable training data via training-data.json for domain-specific optimization
Auto-seeding with 22 diverse documents (Marvel movies, family films, tech concepts)
Modern responsive UI with Bootstrap 5 and real-time database status
Diagnostic endpoints for embedding testing, database status, and reseeding
Clean architecture with dependency injection and provider pattern
Production-ready with configurable providers via appsettings.json
coreFeatures: Understands meaning and intent, not just keywords
Uses embeddings/vectors to measure semantic similarity
Retrieves contextually relevant results even with different wording
Supports hybrid search (semantic + keyword)
Can rerank results using AI models for higher relevance

Task logs and hours reporting
Task statistics
